records.issue_text: app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:27 — `X-Frame-Options: ALLOWALL` is not a valid value and only works because browsers ignore it; the header should be deleted instead of set to a bogus value.
records.rationale: The diff sets `response.headers['X-Frame-Options'] = "ALLOWALL"` in embed_controller.rb. The finding's factual claim is true (ALLOWALL is not a spec value), but the described mechanism is the intended behavior: browsers ignore unrecognized X-Frame-Options values, which disables the default SAMEORIGIN/DENY protection and permits the embedding this controller exists to provide. Moreover, the proposed fix — deleting the header — would not achieve the goal if the app/Rails middleware sets a default X-Frame-Options (e.g. SAMEORIGIN), which is the common reason this override is written this way. No

records.issue_text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35-36 — feed item HTML is passed through `CGI.unescapeHTML` and imported as `raw_html` with no sanitization, so any script/iframe/event handler in a third-party feed is rendered verbatim to all users.
records.rationale: The diff shows poll_feed.rb passing `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` to TopicEmbed.import, which creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`; post.rb's modified `cook` returns `raw` verbatim for that method, and embed/best renders it with `raw post.cooked`. No sanitization step exists anywhere in the chain, so third-party feed HTML (scripts, iframes, handlers) is rendered unsanitized to viewers — a real, verifiable XSS vulnerability introduced by this diff.

records.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:13 — `url` is interpolated unescaped into an `<a href>` tag and stored with `cook_method: raw_html`, bypassing the sanitizer; a single-quote in the embed_url (e.g. `http://host/x'onmouseover='alert(1)`) yields stored XSS. Needs `ERB::Util.html_escape` on both occurrences.
records.rationale: TopicEmbed.import does `contents << ... <a href='#{url}'>` with unescaped interpolation, and the resulting post is created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, where Post#cook returns `raw` directly, bypassing the cooking/sanitization pipeline. The embed view then renders `<%= raw post.cooked %>`, so a malicious URL containing a single quote could break out of the href attribute and inject stored HTML/JS. The mechanism is verifiable from the diff and constitutes a security defect.

records.issue_text: app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:8-10 — the page reloads every 30 seconds forever, even when retrieval can never succeed (wrong host, missing embed_by_username, 404), hammering `/embed/best` from every open tab.
records.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: loading.html.erb sets a 30s setTimeout reload unconditionally, and EmbedController#best enqueues retrieve_topic whenever topic_id is nil; TopicRetriever#retrieve silently does nothing when invalid_host? or embed_by_username user is missing, so /embed/best renders 'loading' again forever, causing an infinite reload loop in every open embed tab. This is a real, verifiable behavior introduced by the diff, though its severity is arguable.
